description: Defines the class Image_Graph_Marker_Icon, a data marker using an image as an icon, including methods for setting icon position and drawing the icon on a canvas.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Icon
classes.description: A class for creating image-based markers with position and rendering capabilities.

methods.name: Image_Graph_Marker_Icon
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the icon marker with filename and optional size.

methods.name: setPointX
methods.description: Set the X coordinate of the icon's center point.

methods.name: setPointY
methods.description: Set the Y coordinate of the icon's center point.

methods.name: _drawMarker
methods.description: Render the icon marker on the canvas at specified coordinates.
